messages:
Ivy: Quick proposal  instead of another giant structured-output PR, let's extract a small 'pattern library' page (canonical examples + tiny validation snippets) and a separate 'runtime snippets' page (SDK fallbacks, parse envelopes, and small heuristics). Smaller diffs please reviewers.

Rahul: +1. I'll take the pattern library (canonical examples + JSON Schema contracts). Plan to add compact examples for: nullable arrays, wrapped unions, and empty-field fallbacks. I'll also add an AJV snippet showing strict vs non-strict validation.

Giselle: I'll own runtime snippets. Will add: SDK 4.1 tryParse envelope, minimal regex fallback, and a tiny exponential-backoff retry example for transient parse errors.

Tom: Suggestion: keep the canonical examples tiny (2-3 lines max) and add a short 'when not to use regex fallback' note (PII, legal, safety). Also put reusable snippets under docs/snippets/parse so they can be included elsewhere.

Mark: I'll run a link audit + redirect map after file moves. Also check the sidebar so nothing disappears from the site nav.

DocsBot: Reminder: add the 'migration-notes' label if call shapes change; run link-checker and docs linter before merging. MDX linter specifically will flag code fences without language tag.

Ivy: timeline: drafts by tomorrow, target land by Thursday afternoon. Keep snippets shallow and copy-paste safe.

Rahul: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/9991 - pattern-library draft. Moved a few examples to docs/patterns/schemas.md and added frontmatter. Left a TODO to add the AJV strict-mode snippet.

Giselle: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/9992 - runtime-snippets draft. Added SDK 4.1 parse example and a compact fallback:```js
// SDK 4.1 parse envelope fallback
try {
  return JSON.parse(text);
} catch (e) {
  const m = /\"result\"\s*:\s*\"([^\"]+)\"/.exec(text);
  return m ? {result: m[1]} : {raw: text, parseError: true};
}
```

Giselle: added a short note: "Regex fallback is best-effort and not suitable for regulated or PII-bearing outputs."

Tom: quick nit: one canonical example had a trailing comma in a JSON block and MDX linter failed. Rahul, can you patch?

Rahul: fixed the trailing-comma issue and added language tags to fenced blocks. Pushed patch.

Mark: opened redirect PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/9993 with a small redirect map and sidebar update. Also added a changelog snippet.

Ivy: good. Giselle, can you add a one-line migration blurb comparing SDK 3.x function-calling payload -> SDK 4.1 structured call envelope? Keep it short.

Giselle: added migration blurb in PR 9992 description: "SDK: function-calling payloads in 3.x map to structured envelopes in 4.1; see snippets for quick conversion."

DocsBot: CI note: all three PRs need the link-checker run; pattern-library PR had one doc-style nit but passed after Rahul's patch. Runtime snippets PR flagged wording around PII; that's resolved. Redirects PR passes link-checker.

Rahul: merged pattern-library PR after a quick editorial pass.

Giselle: merged runtime-snippets PR. Kept snippets intentionally tiny.

Mark: merged redirects PR and added a one-line release-note suggestion: "Docs: add pattern library and runtime parsing snippets; small SDK 4.1 migration note and redirects."

Ivy: added the release-note and closed the loop. Thanks all :rocket:
